title: Add New Tasks
user_story: As a user, I want to type task text into an input field and submit it with a button, so that I can quickly capture items I need to do.
acceptance_criteria: The page displays a text input field and an 'Add Task' button.
Entering text and clicking the button adds the task to the visible list immediately without reloading the page.
Submitting an empty or whitespace-only input does not add a new task and shows a brief validation message.
After successful submission, the input field clears automatically for the next entry.

title: View Task List
user_story: As a user, I want to see all my added tasks displayed in order on the page, so that I can easily review what needs attention.
acceptance_criteria: All submitted tasks appear in a vertical list below the input area.
Tasks are ordered chronologically by creation time consistently.
If no tasks exist, a clear placeholder message like 'No tasks yet' is displayed.
The list updates dynamically as new tasks are added without requiring a page refresh.

title: Complete or Remove Tasks
user_story: As a user, I want to mark tasks as finished or delete them entirely, so that I can track progress and keep my list organized.
acceptance_criteria: Each task in the list includes a checkbox for marking completion and a 'Delete' button.
Checking the box applies a visual indicator (e.g., strikethrough text) to show the task is done.
Clicking the delete button immediately removes the task from the visible list.
Interactions update the UI instantly without page reloads, and completed tasks remain in the list until explicitly deleted.
